description: This Java class 'WorkingDaysHelper' provides utility methods for managing and updating working days related configurations within the Fineract project, including methods to update working days, generate JSON representations for different recurrence scenarios, and retrieve existing working days. It is used in integration tests for Fineract's working days functionality.

classes.name: WorkingDaysHelper
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for manipulating working days configurations in Fineract integration tests.

methods.name: updateWorkingDays
methods.description: Deprecated method to update working days via a PUT request using JSON payload.

methods.name: updateWorkingDaysWithWrongRecurrence
methods.description: Deprecated method to update working days with incorrect recurrence details, for testing error handling.

methods.name: updateWorkingDaysWeekDays
methods.description: Deprecated method to update working days specifying weekdays for weekly recurrence.

methods.name: updateWorkingWeekDaysDaysAsJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string defining weekly recurrence days (Monday to Friday).

methods.name: updateWorkingDaysAsJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for weekly recurrence including all days of the week, with a random recurrence type.

methods.name: updateWorkingDayWithWrongRecur
methods.description: Generates a JSON string with an intentionally wrong recurrence pattern, for testing purposes.

methods.name: workingDaysId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of existing working days configuration from the server.

methods.name: getAllWorkingDays
methods.description: Fetches all working days configuration data from the server as a HashMap.
